name: Pokémon Soundtrack Audio Pack (HGSS & FRLG)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: 17 curated HeartGold/SoulSilver and FireRed/LeafGreen music tracks plus 4 iconic SFX added without replacing vanilla songs.
description: Additive Pokémon soundtrack and sound effects mod curated from the HeartGold/SoulSilver and FireRed/LeafGreen soundtracks. Registers 3 peaceful menu themes, 8 high-energy wild/trainer/gym battle themes into the in-game music rotation, 6 legendary/champion boss themes into the boss pool, and 4 classic SFX stings — all without overwriting or removing a single vanilla PokéBonk track.
highlights: 3 selectable main menu themes: Title Screen (FRLG), Title Screen (HGSS), and National Park (HGSS)
8 battle/run themes added to the in-game playlist alongside vanilla songs
6 legendary and champion boss themes (Ho-Oh, Lugia, Suicune, Champion Lance/Red, Deoxys, Mewtwo/Legendary)
4 short iconic SFX clips routed through PokéBonk's native SFX volume slider
100% additive — every vanilla PokéBonk song remains selectable and intact
